name: custom/feishu-row-count
args: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM data

name: custom/feishu-region-count
args: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "地理位置") AS regions FROM data WHERE "地理位置" IS NOT NULL

name: custom/feishu-category-count
args: SELECT "类别" AS category, COUNT(*) AS n FROM data GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC

name: custom/feishu-amount-stats
args: SELECT ROUND(SUM("金额"), 2) AS total_amount, ROUND(AVG("金额"), 2) AS avg_amount, MIN("金额") AS min_amount, MAX("金额") AS max_amount FROM data

name: custom/feishu-monthly-trend
args: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', "日期"), '%Y-%m') AS month, COUNT(*) AS n FROM data WHERE "日期" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 6
